source: a game that you can destroy buildings with natural disasters with super realistic graphics and super realistic physics and the city is massive

image_prompt.text: Buildings across the city built as breakable assemblies whose collapse under load is the entertainment
Natural disasters layered over the shared city - the event sweeps the map rather than sitting in one place
Streets running between the city blocks, wide enough to walk and drive
A massive dense cityscape of skyscrapers, blocks and streets, rendered photorealistically

notes: Survival was the other candidate because it owns disasters, but the player here causes the destruction rather than surviving it, and Physics Sim is the only preset that owns breakable assemblies. It was close.
A massive city at region scale cannot carry per-building destruction detail in a single framed image; this needs decomposing into districts and the handoff has no way to say so.
Which disasters are in play was never stated.

open_questions.ask: How massive is massive - a few dozen blocks, or a city you cannot cross on foot? It decides whether this is one map or several.
Which disasters - earthquake, tornado, flood, meteor? Each one wants different terrain around the city.
Is there scoring or an objective, or is destruction the whole point?

theme: Modern Urban, photorealistic - concrete, glass and asphalt at high fidelity

coverage_missing.ask: How big is the city in practice?
Does the player stand in the city, or view it from above?

answers.ask: How massive is massive - a few dozen blocks, or a city you cannot cross on foot? It decides whether this is one map or several.
answers.answer: Make it one large continuous city map that takes a long time to cross on foot, with many dense blocks and varied building sizes.

answers.ask: Which disasters - earthquake, tornado, flood, meteor? Each one wants different terrain around the city.
answers.answer: Include earthquake, tornado, flood, and meteor disasters, all usable in the same city.

answers.ask: Is there scoring or an objective, or is destruction the whole point?
answers.answer: Destruction is the whole point; this should be a sandbox with no scoring or required objective.
